declared difference (truth fix T5, equal-value skip, as lint-persist-hot-write): a simple-typed slot only dirties
the station when its value changes (Baja's ComplexSlotMap equal-value skip, ComplexSlotMap.java:1239/:860/:637), so
the persisted write that qualifies a hot changed() must be one that can change every cycle (hotwrite.Hot): Edge
mirrors an edge-flipped model field and no longer WARNs; Acc mirrors an accumulator (hours[0] += dtH) and does.

class Acc {
  static final Property xHours = newProperty(0, 0d, null);
  static final Property xLocked = newProperty(0, false, null);
  public void changed(Property p, Context cx) {
    if (p == a) execute();
    if (p == b) execute();
    if (p == c) execute();
    if (p == d) execute();
    if (p == e) execute();
    if (p == f) execute();
    if (p == g) execute();
  }
  void execute() { setXHours(m.hours[0]); }
}
-- Edge.java --
class Edge {
  static final Property xHours = newProperty(0, 0d, null);
  static final Property xLocked = newProperty(0, false, null);
  public void changed(Property p, Context cx) {
    if (p == a) execute();
    if (p == b) execute();
    if (p == c) execute();
    if (p == d) execute();
    if (p == e) execute();
    if (p == f) execute();
    if (p == g) execute();
  }
  void execute() { setXLocked(m.locked[0]); }
}
-- M.java --
class M {
  double[] hours; boolean[] locked;
  void step(double dtH) { hours[0] += dtH; if (trip) locked[0] = true; }
}
